serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Organizations need a way to get work done, not just talk about it. Smartsheet Gov is a secure and reliable platform that helps Federal agencies bring innovation, collaboration, and transparency to government initiatives. It helps eliminate productivity killers by automating repetitive tasks with simple rules that you can easily create without help from IT. With Smartsheet Gov, your agency can operate with an increased sense of agility, manage work in real time, and make better decisions with timely and accurate information. Find out why the GSA, Library of Congress, National Institutes of Health, National Parks Service, and US Department of Veterans Affairs trust Smartsheet for their strategic initiatives.
